summary: Yoriichi Tsugikuni was a legendary Demon Slayer who lived during the Sengoku Era and is regarded as the strongest Demon Slayer to have ever existed. He was the younger twin brother of Michikatsu Tsugikuni and the creator of Sun Breathing, the original Breathing Style from which all other Breathing Styles were derived. Born with the Demon Slayer Mark and the ability to perceive the Transparent World, Yoriichi possessed extraordinary physical abilities, swordsmanship, perception, and combat intelligence.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range with Nichirin Sword, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

notes: Prime Yoriichi. He was born with the Demon Slayer Mark and possessed the Transparent World from birth. His Sun Breathing consists of twelve forms, which he could combine into the Thirteenth Form specifically designed to continuously target Muzan Kibutsuji's twelve vital organs. His Bright Red Nichirin Blade produces extreme heat capable of preventing demons from regenerating wounds. His Selfless State completely conceals his fighting spirit, emotions, and intent. The VS Battles profile rates him at least Low 7-B, likely far higher, with at least Relativistic speed, likely far higher. He is described as the strongest Demon Slayer in history.
